transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: A12 Terminal 1 and A13 Terminal 2 stations are served by Taoyuan Airport MRT express and commuter trains. Express and commuter trains arrive alternately, approximately every 7.5 minutes. Buses depart from the B1 area of the Terminal 1 arrivals hall and from the outdoor walkway on the east side of the Terminal 2 arrivals hall on Level 1.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Taiwan Pelican Express provides luggage storage and delivery in the terminals’ public areas. Round-the-clock counters are on Level 1 of Terminals 1 and 2. In Terminal 2, the Level 3 counter is open from 06:00 to 23:30; another counter on Level 1 of Terminal 1 opens from 09:00 to 17:00.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: The airport provides free Wi-Fi in the terminals’ public areas. To connect, select Airport Free WiFi in your device settings and open a browser.
